# spyro redis

Run Redis commands on remote server.

## Before you run it

`redis-cli` wrappers: `ping`, `info [-s section]`, `stats`, and `cli <args>` for anything else (that one can write; be careful with FLUSHALL etc.).

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro redis`

```text
Usage: spyro redis [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Run Redis commands on remote server.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  cli    Run an arbitrary redis-cli command.
  info   Show Redis server info.
  ping   Ping Redis server.
  stats  Show Redis key metrics (connections, commands, keyspace).
```

### `spyro redis cli`

```text
Usage: spyro redis cli [OPTIONS] COMMAND...

  Run an arbitrary redis-cli command.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro redis info`

```text
Usage: spyro redis info [OPTIONS]

  Show Redis server info.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  -s, --section TEXT  Info section (server, stats, keyspace, etc.)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro redis ping`

```text
Usage: spyro redis ping [OPTIONS]

  Ping Redis server.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `spyro redis stats`

```text
Usage: spyro redis stats [OPTIONS]

  Show Redis key metrics (connections, commands, keyspace).

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name  [required]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
